scenario.zh: 大学生通过 iMessage 自然对话获得个性化约会推荐,从聊天到见面一站式体验
scenario.en: College students get personalized date matches through natural iMessage chat, seamless from conversation to meetup

instruction.zh: 决定如何开始你的约会匹配之旅
instruction.en: Decide how to start your dating match journey

output.zh: 系统将根据共同爱好(运动、音乐、社团活动)推荐匹配对象,侧重长期兴趣契合度
output.en: System matches based on shared interests like sports, music, clubs for long-term compatibility

output.zh: 系统根据即将发生的校园活动(音乐节、体育赛事)推荐匹配,侧重短期见面机会
output.en: System matches around upcoming campus events like concerts, games for immediate meetup chances

instruction.zh: 选择你希望 AI 如何引导对话
instruction.en: Choose how AI guides your conversation

output.zh: AI 生成轻松话题开场,如'你更喜欢图书馆还是咖啡馆学习?'减少初次对话压力
output.en: AI suggests light topics like 'Do you prefer library or café for studying?' to ease first chat

output.zh: AI 提供更深入问题引导,如'最近有什么让你兴奋的课程或项目?'建立有意义连接
output.en: AI offers deeper prompts like 'Any exciting course or project lately?' for meaningful connection

instruction.zh: 对比两个匹配对象的简介和推荐理由
instruction.en: Compare profiles and match reasons for two candidates

label.zh: 匹配 A:同专业学长,共同参加创业社团
label.en: Match A: Same major upperclassman, shared startup club

output.zh: 推荐理由:你们都对科技创业感兴趣,最近都在关注 AI 应用方向,下周社团有聚会
output.en: Reason: Both interested in tech startups and AI applications, club meetup next week

label.zh: 匹配 B:不同学院,都喜欢户外徒步
label.en: Match B: Different school, both enjoy hiking

output.zh: 推荐理由:你们都喜欢周末户外活动,对方刚组织了校园登山小组,正在招募新成员
output.en: Reason: Both love weekend outdoor activities, they just started campus hiking group recruiting

instruction.zh: 选择如何从聊天过渡到线下见面
instruction.en: Choose how to transition from chat to in-person meeting

output.zh: AI 建议参加社团聚会或校园活动,在轻松氛围中自然认识,降低一对一见面的紧张感
output.en: AI suggests club gathering or campus event for relaxed natural introduction, less pressure

output.zh: AI 推荐校园内安全咖啡馆,提供对话话题建议,帮助安排具体时间和地点
output.en: AI recommends safe on-campus café, suggests conversation topics and helps arrange time

takeaway.zh: Ditto 将约会匹配融入 iMessage 日常对话,通过 AI 引导从兴趣发现到线下见面全流程
takeaway.en: Ditto integrates dating into everyday iMessage chat, AI-guided journey from interest discovery to meetup
